packageRules.description: Auto-update (2026-10-27): non-major updates merge into main on their own once the required `test` check passes (branch protection, strict). main never deploys, so prod still moves only via bin/deploy.sh. Rules below opt specific packages back out.
0.x packages (e.g. chess.js) can break on a minor bump, so they get their own grouped PR that waits for a human instead of riding the automerged group.

One Postgres pin lives in docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.dev.yml, docker-compose.benchmark.yml and ci.yml; group them so CI always tests the version prod runs. Patch and digest bumps automerge (rule 1); a major needs pg_upgrade, so it waits for dashboard approval.
Python is held at 3.14: the pinned onnxruntime 1.29.0 ships only cp314 wheels (>=1.30 segfaults on the Maia model, see the next rule). Lift this cap together with the onnxruntime bump.

onnxruntime / onnxruntime-node are pinned at 1.29.0: >=1.30 segfaults loading the vendored maia3_simplified.onnx (exit 139, reproduced 2026-10-09 on 1.30.0 and 1.31.0). A bump must pass the Phase 218 parity spike (scripts/maia_parity_spike.py, verify_value_head.mjs) first.

js-yaml and fast-uri exist only as npm overrides pinning patched transitive versions. A major would force the next major onto consumers that declare ^4 / ^3 (cosmiconfig, ajv@8), so disable majors; minor and patch floors still flow through the grouped branch.
